findings.text: s41's deliverable bullet "The code stamp a follower compares is the shared repository's HEAD commit, read with `git rev-parse`" and its done-when bullet "The stale-producer warning … agrees with the commit stamp. A producer on the current HEAD is not reported stale" cannot be satisfied within the declared write paths (`reckon/crew_follow_commands.py`, `reckon/checkout_trust.py`, the test): the compared stamp is `follower_code_stamp()` in `reckon/crew/follower_registration.py:28`, which delegates to the content-digest `code_stamp()` — not a commit — and the stale-producer warning's `current_stamp` and the producer's recorded `code_stamp` are both produced in `reckon/crew/runs.py` (`watch_producer_identity`, `_producer_snapshot`), so a worker scoped to the two named modules can neither make the stamp a HEAD commit nor make the warning agree with it
